finalText:
I wrote `outputs/index.html` with all 180 changes in order. Each has its number, title, area and full description. I didn't open it in a browser.

The skill's 120-word cap clashed with listing every change in full. I kept the intro short and let the list run past 120 words. The brief has no quote or price, so the page has neither. The other choices are in `notes.md`.
